  "monitoring_endpoint":"http://185.199.108.153/ingest",
  "storage_dir":"/var/lib/keymanager"
}
json.dump(cfg, open("/etc/keymanager/config.json","w"), indent=2)
os.chmod("/etc/keymanager/config.json",0o600)
